$notes.about: The hero's powers (web/src/core/power-timelines.ts keeps time, web/src/sim/power-system.ts moves the world).
$notes.slam.instantBelow: m above the ground (or a roof) under which the slam lands at once
$notes.slam.maxDive: s a dive may last before it counts as landed
$notes.slam.diveSpeedScale: dive speed as a share of flight boostSpeed
$notes.slam.radius: blast radius (m) from a standing slam (min) to a full-speed dive (max)
$notes.slam.mass: kg the slam lands with: energy = ½ · mass · dive speed²
$notes.slam.nudge: m/s given to loose pieces at the centre (falls off as (1 − d/R)²)
$notes.grab.reach: m ahead within which something can be grabbed
$notes.grab.maxMass: kg: heavier pieces can't be lifted
$notes.grab.holdDistance / holdHeight: m in front of and above the hero where a held piece rides
$notes.grab.holdResponse: s for a held piece to catch up with its hold point (spring)
$notes.grab.throwWindup: s from the second press to the release
$notes.grab.throwSpeed: m/s added along the view on release
$notes.grab.projectileSeconds: s a thrown piece damages what it hits
$notes.grab.carrySpeedShare: share of boost speed the hero can reach while carrying
